journal_lines: Fields at the edge of the plains. Someone's crop, untended. We cleared the animals and took what was left.
Abandoned farm. The harvest was still standing. Not for long.
Chased off whatever was eating the field. Took the rest ourselves.
Overgrown field on the plains. Animals in the crop, crop in the field. Sorted both.
Farmhouse with the door open and nobody home. The field had been waiting for someone to claim it.
Scarecrow with a sparrow on its hat. The sparrow was the only thing keeping order out there.
Took grain by the mouthful. Took some animals too. Both had had their fill of the field.
Long rows of something that wanted picking. Picked some, scared off the rest of what was picking, came home with both.
